live_predictions.description: Application-facing live prediction dataset. The backend resolves the champion long and short models and writes their probabilities to stable column names — consumers never reference model IDs.
live_predictions.champion_model_source: config/models.json -> active models filtered by asset_id and target_name prefix (trg_l_ = long, trg_s_ = short)

column_docs.open_time: UTC minute timestamp copied from the features dataset.
column_docs.close: Close price copied from the features dataset for display and joins.
column_docs.trg_l_fw60_q90: Long fact target (binary label): 1 if forward max return over 60 bars >= 90th-percentile threshold. Copied from the features dataset.
column_docs.trg_s_fw60_q10: Short fact target (binary label): 1 if forward min return over 60 bars <= 10th-percentile threshold. Copied from the features dataset.
column_docs.long_pred: Champion long model probability output. Always reflects the current active long champion regardless of model ID.
column_docs.short_pred: Champion short model probability output. Always reflects the current active short champion regardless of model ID.

signal.direction_source: Inferred from target column prefix: trg_l_ -> long signal above threshold, trg_s_ -> short signal above threshold.
signal.note: Tune this threshold with model evaluation before using it as a live trading cutoff.

evaluation_predictions.description: Model comparison predictions are generated outside the live predictions dataset.
evaluation_predictions.recommended_storage: Model/evaluation artifacts under models/<model_id>/ or a dedicated evaluation dataset.
